messages:
nina_release: Planning adaptive rollout for SDK 4.2 tonight 22:30 UTC. There's a change to routing heuristics that prefers newer runtime kernels by default. Proposing adaptive pin strategy: start unpinned canaries, if regressions appear apply short TTL capacity-class pins.

omar_sre: Sounds good. Keep pins short (24h) and scoped. We'll avoid global pins unless severe. Recommend telemetry triggers and exact rbctl commands in runbook.

lucy_eng: Patch 4.2 changes header behavior (X-REDWOOD-KERNEL-PREF). Old runtimes ignore header and may route to fallback kernels, which can change outputs. We added REDWOOD_SDK_KERNEL_LEGACY env toggle to revert.

pete_qa: Quick canary results: NA/EU unpinned canaries green; APAC had a small spike in rerank diffs ~1.6% on legacy kernels. With kernel_legacy=true diffs drop to 0.3%.

zoe_prod: For Dedicated customers we should include tenant opt-in and a KB. Also inform account leads for any tenants running legacy kernels.

omar_sre: Proposed triggers to pin capacity-class: error rate +4% sustained 5m OR quality drift >1.5% sustained 10m OR p95 latency +250ms for 10m. Pin command example: `rbctl runtime pin --capacity-class gpu_h100 --runtime-version v3.2 --ttl 24h --reason "sdk4.2 adaptive hold"`. Unpin: `rbctl runtime unpin --capacity-class gpu_h100 --reason "canary passed"`.

nina_release: We'll do staged plan: 1) unpinned canaries 22:30-23:00 UTC 2) if APAC shows drift, pin gpu_h100_fallback and small_vm for 24h 3) re-run canaries and lift. Manual owners: @omar_sre then fallback @nina_release.

lucy_eng: Hotpatch: if needed we'll ship 4.2.1 with REDWOOD_SDK_KERNEL_LEGACY=true default. ETA 21:50 UTC. If that lands, skip pin.

deploybot: [deploybot] canary schedule posted: NA 22:30 UTC (15m), EU 22:50 UTC (15m), APAC 23:10 UTC (15m). Telemetry hooks enabled.

pete_qa: 4.2.1 published at 21:46 UTC. APAC canary metrics now within noise. No auto-pin triggered.

omar_sre: Monitoring window 2h post-release with 1m scrape cadence for latency and 30s for errors. Alert thresholds set per runbook. Manual piners stand by.

zoe_prod: I'll add KB and release note blurb referencing tenant pin CLI and link to migration steps.

nina_release: Closing thread. TL;DR: SDK 4.2 rolled with hotpatch 4.2.1, adaptive capacity-class pin plan on standby, triggers defined, manual owners assigned.
